summary.scope: Native unordered joints, independent axis projection/order facts, exact unmeasured equivalences, coarse hypotheses, ordinal support/doubt and separate goals. No original endpoint partner, source word, teacher family or completion template enters search.
summary.search: Bounded authored proposal and criticism, not model training. Guessed pairings, ordinal embeddings and gap repetitions are explicit hypotheses. Rank prioritizes hard evidence conflicts, missing rays, blocked goals, default conflicts and sampling cost.
summary.confidence: Four connected ordinal rungs, no calibrated probabilities. Support and opposition remain separate. Duplicated streams do not add certainty. Goals do not establish observation.
summary.retention: Three inspection samples and one selected native replay state per profile; other search outcomes are aggregated. Snapshots deliberately omit earlier policy histories. No exact replay promise for discarded attempts.
summary.limits: Finite straight passages and existing native D4 metric interpretation. General near-length tolerance, arbitrary angular partitions, curves, global truth-maintenance and learned proposal policies remain open. Default crossing/overlap penalties are not universal evidence of invalidity.
